data_quality_notes.market_size: DaaS market figures vary across research firms ($6B-$8B range for 2025-2026). Used DataM Intelligence figure ($6.34B) as it aligns with multiple corroborating sources.
data_quality_notes.delivery_volume: Zipline 2M deliveries (Jan 2026) is directly confirmed by company press release. Wing 750K+ is from industry coverage; Wing has not published an official cumulative figure.
data_quality_notes.market_share: Market share estimates for Wing, Zipline, Amazon are approximations based on publicly reported delivery volumes and geographic coverage — no authoritative third-party market share breakdown exists for the delivery drone segment as of research date.
data_quality_notes.growth_rates: growth_5y (+345%) derived from delivery drone segment estimates: ~$330M baseline in 2021 (back-calculated from $1.47B 2026 value at 35.69% CAGR) vs $1.47B in 2026. growth_1y (+38% YoY) and growth_3m (+43% CAGR) from Mordor Intelligence delivery drone CAGR.
data_quality_notes.search_volume: ~75K/mo is an estimate combining 'drone delivery', 'autonomous drones', and 'delivery drone' keyword cluster. Not verified via paid SEO tool — mark as [estimated].
